correctness.rationale: On any labeled binary n-cycle n>=5 with 4 distinct neighbors ±1,±2, satisfaction means at least 2 agree. A singleton run can be happy only if both neighboring runs are singletons, forcing full alternating checkerboard; absent singletons any length-two run endpoint has at most one matching neighbor; every run>=3 is sufficient. Hence the exhaustive static class is constants, 2 even checkerboards, or alternating runs all length>=3. With k runs of each type, weak compositions after removing 3 from each yield binom(m-2k-1,k-1)binom(n-m-2k-1,k-1), weighted n/k for labeled positions. Summing m gives H_n=2+2[even]+sum_{k<=n/6}(n/k)binom(n-4k-1,2k-1). Six-state capped-run transfer has characteristic (t³-t²-1)(t³-t²+1) and primitive Perron root λ=1.465571..., so H_n~λ^n. Independent direct satisfaction predicate for all 16,352 words at n=5..13 exactly matches all S_{n,m}; check is finite and all-n run proof independent.
